naive_control.scope: Specific wrapper that controls every trial gate and leaves off-arm ancillas zero.
naive_control.explanation: Measurement outcomes distinguish the run and do-not-run arms and can damage their superposition.
naive_control.proposal: Do not apply this naive wrapper. The separately verified controlled replacement circuits are available for accepted inputs; source recovery alone does not fix control leakage.
